screen.title: Checkout

payment.question: How would you like to pay?

peek.title: Your basket

problem.distanceNote: That address is {distance} from the store. We deliver up to {max}.
problem.needsMapTitle: This address needs a map location
problem.storeClosedTitle: The store is not taking orders
problem.duplicateTitle: This order is already being placed
